gaps.gap: Class-a coverage is limited to the March-2026 central corridor (camera path U 4.9..19.5, V -57.3..-15.5). The rear row #9-#16 (U -49..6), west front row #5-#8 (U -83..-8) and east units #1-#2 (U 28..62) have no registered geometry.
No observed shop partition, rear wall, depth or door width for any unit; the 1.8 door and 3.6 height are visual estimates.

Vertical circulation: no registered escalator flight, balustrade or upper landing; the 2F slab opening is unmeasured; the escalator at #9 and both elevator/stair cores have no metric evidence; no stationary stair was identified.
No registered column positions or grid (right-core-metal-return fails; left-core-column-face insufficient).
Registered ceiling is only 31.55 + 24.47 model-units² against a 5734 added floor; no ceiling heights exist for the rear row, west or east.
No 1F extinguisher, hydrant, alarm or exit-sign positions; only 2 AED registry entries with unregistered lat/lon.
No 1F ticket machine, info desk, bench or ATM evidence.
Entrances other than GATE3/4 are unregistered; door leaves and widths are unknown; entry_high_fascia is unresolved.
No metric evidence later than March 2026: the May photos are uncalibrated, the August board is schematic and the September video is short and edited.
Coordinates are source-model units with no survey scale; tender areas are 'not precisely measured'; no current as-built drawing exists (the 2009 construction PDF is historical).
Toilets, lockers, TMO, Zimcarry, KTX특송 and the wheelchair charger are topology only.

Failing observed surfaces need independent third-view support (office-public-frontage, office-lower-wall-panels, metal return, rails, left column). The ARTBOX pier needs third-view edges before constructionApproved.
The 2F-registered 복순도가/꽃들 storefronts must be excluded from 1F.
